form.name: Salvaged Vault
form.lore: Dragged out of a scrapyard on the edge of the Ashveil wastes and welded shut with whatever was lying around. It rattles in the wind, but it closes. Every raider in the canyon laughs at it. For now.

forms.name: Salvaged Vault
forms.lore: Dragged out of a scrapyard on the edge of the Ashveil wastes and welded shut with whatever was lying around. It rattles in the wind, but it closes. Every raider in the canyon laughs at it. For now.

forms.name: Reinforced Vault
forms.lore: WARDEN, the vault's cranky caretaker AI, found a crate of bolts and got ideas. Cross-braces, second plating, a real lock. The Rustjaw Raiders now need more than a crowbar and optimism.

forms.name: Powered Vault
forms.lore: Somebody finally plugged it in. Thick cables snake down the cliff into a humming green core, and the vault starts to feel alive. WARDEN swears the hum is purring.

forms.name: Armored Vault
forms.lore: Layer on layer of reclaimed tank armour, each plate stamped with a tally of raids it has shrugged off. Bandits have started leaving the canyon a different way home.

forms.name: Energized Vault
forms.lore: The core overflowed. Blue energy now runs through every seam like veins of lightning in a bottle, and a shimmering shield hangs in the air in front of the door. The Chrome Widows sent a scout. The scout sent a postcard: nope.

forms.name: Guardian Vault
forms.lore: Two dormant sentinel pylons unfolded out of the rock and took up position. They do not move. They do not blink. They simply watch the canyon, and the canyon has become very polite.

forms.name: Ancient Vault
forms.lore: Digging deeper to anchor the frame, WARDEN hit something older than the colony: carved alien stone that fused with the steel as if it had been waiting. Violet light now leaks from glyphs nobody can read.

forms.name: Legendary Vault
forms.lore: Gold-orange light. The colour every loot hunter dreams about. Word has spread across Ashveil that this vault is the real thing, and the raiders who come now arrive just to look at it.

forms.name: Sovereign Vault
forms.lore: The vault no longer sits in the canyon; the canyon arranges itself around the vault. Great rings of armour rotate slowly around the door like a crown, and WARDEN has started calling itself Your Excellency.

forms.name: Celestial Vault
forms.lore: The rings lifted off the ground. The vault now hangs in a column of starlight above the canyon floor, tethered by beams of energy. On clear nights you can see it from the other side of the planet.

forms.name: Singularity Vault
forms.lore: The core folded space around itself. Light bends near the door; sand falls upward in slow spirals. WARDEN reports that the vault is now technically in four places at once, all of them locked.

forms.name: Eternal Vault
forms.lore: The final form. The vault has become a landmark, a legend and a lighthouse. Raiders tell stories about it around their fires. The only key that fits is the one you forged week by week.
